env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build -o $WORK/bin/receiver$GOEXE ./caller
exec $WORK/bin/receiver$GOEXE
stdout '^7$'
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./lib
	./caller
)

-- w/lib/go.mod --
module example.com/receiverhole/lib

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --

package lib

type Box struct{}

func (b *Box) Value() int { return 7 }

func Check(b *Box) int { return 7 }

-- w/caller/go.mod --
module example.com/receivercaller

go 1.27

-- w/caller/main.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"example.com/receiverhole/lib"
)

func value() (n int) {
	defer func() { recover() }()
	var b *lib.Box
	return b.Value()
}

func main() { fmt.Println(value()) }
